text:
mae: quick flag — when previewing the runtime quickstart in staging I hit a 403 on the hero image ("/guides/runtime/quickstart") :frowning: can someone claim a tiny rehost + alt-text fix? @sandeep you edited this section last sprint iirc

sandeep: hmm saw a 404/403 from the link-scan alert earlier. do you have the exact asset path? i can check permissions quickly

mae: the page shows image URL -> https://s3.internal.redwood/guides/runtime/quickstart/hero.png (preview fails). staging logs show: `GET /guides/runtime/quickstart -> 403 for /guides/runtime/quickstart/hero.png`

link-scan-bot: automated-scan found: 1 asset error in /guides/runtime/quickstart — 403 on s3://guides/runtime/quickstart/hero.png at 1763009800

olivia: i can rehost into our assets bucket (internal-assets) and update the mdx reference. need write access to the original s3 path or the working copy. also can tidy the alt text while i'm there :+1:

sandeep: i actually moved some runtime images into internal-ks-assets last month but forgot to update the doc reference. the file is here now: s3://internal-ks-assets/runtime/quickstart/hero-v2.png. quick curl to preview returns 200 for me: `curl -I https://s3.internal-ks-assets/runtime/quickstart/hero-v2.png`

olivia: perfect — i'll open a tiny PR that swaps the path and updates alt text to "Runtime quickstart hero — minimal example" plus a one-line note under the screenshot about fallback images. i'll include the curl check in the PR description.

olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — changes: update image path, alt text, add fallback note. includes smoke test: `curl -I https://s3.internal-ks-assets/runtime/quickstart/hero-v2.png` and local mdx preview screenshot attached.

mae: thanks — i'll review after stand (about 12:45 PST). tag me for urgent if you want faster review.

julian: small request — can we also add a quick inline comment in the runtime guide about preferred hosting (internal-ks-assets) so future edits don't point to staging buckets? two sentences is enough.

olivia: will do, adding a 1-liner and a tiny dev note in the docs code comment.

mae: quick CR note — nothing big, focus on link change and alt text. if it's green i'll approve. :thumbsup:

mae: approved in PR comments — LGTM other than one wording nit which i left inline.

sandeep: small follow-up — i updated the S3 lifecycle policy to keep these runtime images for 180 days to avoid accidental deletes. filing a separate ops note for that.

olivia: merged PR and kicked a staging rebuild.

deploy-bot: staging-site: rebuild triggered by docs PR #4123 — finished at 1763015070, status: success

mae: verified staging preview and the hero shows correctly now. closing the thread, thanks everyone :sparkles:
